content.comment_body: I purchased five [product_name] modules. My main issue is that transfer speeds are extremely slow, making the process nearly unusable. My [product_name] Web Editor project is only around 1 MB, but transferring it to the module takes nearly five minutes, and downloading has the same delay. Has anyone else experienced this? Thank you, [user_name].

Unfortunately, this slow transfer rate is a known limitation of the [product_name] [version_no] module and cannot be improved. [company_name] has not provided any official statements regarding this issue. The [product_name] [version_no] module is simply not fast enough for these tasks.

Hi, [company_name] introduced encryption for downloading a [product_name] Web Editor project via the memory card, which slows down the transfer for security reasons. One workaround is to remove the memory card from the module and download the project to it locally using a PC. To do this, insert your memory card into your PC and select the appropriate button as indicated in the reference image. Hope this helps.
Thank you for your responses; perhaps this suggestion will be helpful. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are reporting that transferring a 1 MB project using the [product_name] Web Editor to the [product_name] [version_no] module is very slow, with each transfer taking about five minutes. This issue is widely recognized and is linked to encryption implemented for security. No official solution has been provided, and users have suggested manually moving files via a PC as a workaround, which is inefficient and disappointing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect much faster and more efficient file transfer with the [product_name] [version_no] module and [product_name] Web Editor, especially for small projects, and are dissatisfied with prolonged delays.
